cards.name: Summer Camp
cards.description: Campers participate in organized activities and games focused on peer relations, conflict resolution and team building. Activities include swimming, hiking, recreation and field trips.

financial_aid.text: Eligibility/priority is determined by Eliada. First priority is given to unserved children, followed by underserved children.

cards.review_notes: The camp page does not explicitly identify a summer year or give season dates; fees are assigned to 2026 as current fallback information. Eligibility is stated as rising 1st graders through age 12, so no minimum age or maximum grade was inferred. A wait-list form is offered, but the page does not explicitly state that all camp enrollment is waitlisted. Registration is by contacting Melody Gonzalez at mgonzalez@eliada.org or (828) 348-3360.

cards.name: Junior Volunteers
cards.description: A summer camp junior volunteer program for youth ages 13–16.
cards.review_notes: The summer camp page states that ages 13–16 may serve as Junior Volunteers and lists a $75 fee under both private pay and subsidy, but does not specify the fee's unit, duties, separate hours or dates. The undated fee is assigned to 2026 as fallback information. Retained as the existing summer youth volunteer offering; confirm its supervised program format and fee unit with the coordinator.
